items.title: Hiremii Limited to Seek Shareholder Approval for Rebranding as AQYR Limited at 2026 AGM - Kalkine Media
items.raw_summary:
Hiremii Limited (ASX:HMI), an AI-driven Workforce Intelligence firm serving the global energy, resources, and infrastructure sectors, has announced plans to request shareholder approval to rename the company AQYR Limited during its 2026 Annual General Meeting. 

 Key Highlights 
 
 Hiremii plans to propose renaming the company to AQYR Limited at the 2026 Annual General Meeting for shareholder approval. 
 The company achieved record annual revenue of $32 million in FY26, marking its highest full-year gross profit and first positive adjusted EBITDA (unaudited). 
 The name AQYR, pronounced "acquire," reflects the companyâs dual focus on enabling clients to acquire talent and driving growth through acquisitions alongside organic expansion. 
 An Investor Presentation was released concurrently with the name change announcement. 
 
 Shareholder Vote Proposed for AQYR Limited Rebranding Per the official filing, the name change is contingent upon shareholder approval at the 2026 Annual General Meeting. The company explained that the new name aligns with its evolution from a traditional recruitment and labour-hire provider to an AI-powered Workforce Intelligence enterprise. Workforce Intelligence integrates proprietary workforce data, artificial intelligence, and deep industry knowledge to assist clients in understanding workforce markets, identifying suitable talent, and securing critical hires. This rebranding follows a year marked by significant operational advancements. FY26 Financial Performance Highlights Hiremii reported record annual revenue of $32 million for FY26, as detailed in its June 2026 Quarterly Activities and Cashflow Reports. This milestone represents the companyâs strongest gross profit performance to date and its inaugural period of positive adjusted EBITDA, noted as unaudited. These financial results establish a robust foundation to accelerate the companyâs Workforce Intelligence strategy under the AQYR brand. The filing did not provide additional financial breakdowns. AQYR Brand Vision and Strategic Focus The filing emphasizes that the AQYR name, pronounced "acquire," embodies two core strategic pillars: supporting clients in acquiring talent through proprietary data, AI, and specialized industry expertise, and driving growth via complementary acquisitions alongside organic development and an enhanced revenue mix. The company anticipates improving revenue quality and scaling efficiently by adopting innovative agentic working methods. Under the AQYR identity, the company aims to build a leading Workforce Intelligence business anchored by a profitable operating base, strong enterprise customer relationships, and commercialized technology. items.pme_pt: Empresários que já posicionaram a marca precisam entender que Gen Z exige evolução constante na comunicação e na oferta — sem acompanhamento estratégico contínuo, você perde relevância.

items.title: OpenAI’s influencer backlash exposes a bigger problem: Can AI be marketed like beauty and fashion? - storyboard18.com
items.raw_summary: OpenAI recently hosted roughly 30 creators at Wildflower Farms, a luxury resort in New York’s Hudson Valley, for an event creators referred to as “OpenAI Summer Camp”. The retreat included sessions around OpenAI tools alongside meals, outdoor activities and branded merchandise
items.title_pt: Reação Negativa de Influenciadores da OpenAI Expõe um Problema Maior: A IA Pode Ser Comercializada como Beleza e Moda?
items.summary_pt: Análise crítica sobre como marcas de tecnologia usam influenciadores e eventos para construir credibilidade, e os riscos de autenticidade.
items.pme_pt: Mostra que a estratégia de influencers exige direção contínua: o que funciona em beleza pode não funcionar em tech, e sinais de inautenticidade danificam a marca rapidamente.
items.link_kelly: Direção (acompanhamento estratégico contínuo); marcas que usam influencers precisam revisar continuamente a autenticidade e direção de suas parcerias para não perder credibilidade.
